name: interactive
comment: Latency-sensitive front end, selected by cgroup. Preempting, so scx_layered forces both disallow_*_after_us to 'never'.

name: bg_worker_0
comment: One named worker inside the background cgroup. Two ANDed terms, so a sibling in the same cgroup with a different thread name falls through.

name: everything_else
comment: scx_layered treats a task that matches no layer as a fatal error, so the last layer must be a catch-all: matches is exactly [[]].
